```{r}
make_locus <- function(file) {

  fname <- basename(file)

  # Extract phenotype: ku or kuf
  phenotype <- sub(
    "^([^_]+)_.*$",
    "\\1",
    fname
  )

  # Extract lead SNP
  lead_snp <- sub(
    "^(ku|kuf)_(rs[0-9]+)_.*$",
    "\\2",
    fname
  )

  # Human-readable phenotype
  phenotype_label <- if (phenotype == "ku") {
    "Khat Use"
  } else if (phenotype == "kuf") {
    "Khat Use Frequency"
  } else {
    toupper(phenotype)
  }

  # Read regional GWAS data
  dat <- fread(file)

  # Lead SNP row
  lead_row <- dat[
    MarkerName == lead_snp
  ]

  if (nrow(lead_row) == 0) {
    stop("Lead SNP not found: ", lead_snp)
  }

  chr <- lead_row$CHR[1]

  # Construct locus
  loc <- locus(
    data = dat,
    index_snp = lead_snp,
    fix_window = 1e6,
    chrom = "CHR",
    pos = "BP",
    labs = "MarkerName",
    p = "P-value",
    LD = "r2",
    ens_db = "EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86"
  )

  # Store convenient metadata
  attr(loc, "phenotype") <- phenotype
  attr(loc, "phenotype_label") <- phenotype_label
  attr(loc, "lead_snp") <- lead_snp
  attr(loc, "chr") <- chr

  return(loc)
}
```

```{r}
# plot testing w/out recombination peaks
test_file <- files[
  grepl("ku_rs189679719_", basename(files))
]

test_loc <- make_locus(test_file)

summary(test_loc)

locus_plot(
  test_loc,
  labels = "index"
)
```
```{r}
test_loc_recomb <- link_recomb(test_loc)

locus_plot(
  test_loc_recomb,
  labels = "index"
)
```
```{r}
# object w/ all loci
loci <- lapply(
  files,
  make_locus
)

names(loci) <- basename(files)

length(loci)
```
```{r}
# apply recombination rate to all loci
loci_recomb <- lapply(
  seq_along(loci),
  function(i) {

    cat(
      "Adding recombination:",
      i,
      "/",
      length(loci),
      "\n"
    )

    link_recomb(
      loci[[i]]
    )
  }
)

names(loci_recomb) <- names(loci)
```

```{r}
# plot all loci w/ recombination rates


for (i in seq_along(loci_recomb)) {

  loc <- loci_recomb[[i]]

  phenotype_label <- attr(loc, "phenotype_label")
  lead_snp <- attr(loc, "lead_snp")
  chr <- attr(loc, "chr")

  p <- locus_ggplot(
    loc,
    labels = "index",
    nudge_y = 1.0,
    recomb_col = "goldenrod"
  ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        phenotype_label,
        ": ",
        lead_snp,
        " — Chromosome ",
        chr,
        "+/- 500kb"
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 14,
        margin = margin(b = 15)
      )
    )

  print(p)
}
```
```{r}
# make plot w/out legend
for (i in seq_along(loci_recomb)) {

  loc <- loci_recomb[[i]]

  phenotype_label <- attr(loc, "phenotype_label")
  lead_snp <- attr(loc, "lead_snp")
  chr <- attr(loc, "chr")

  p <- locus_ggplot(
    loc,
    labels = "index",
    nudge_y = 1.5,
    recomb_col = "goldenrod",
    legend_pos = NULL
  ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        phenotype_label,
        ": ",
        lead_snp,
        " (+/-500kb) — Chromosome ",
        chr
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 14,
        margin = margin(b = 15)
      )
    )

  print(p)
}
```
